presets.name: Photo Realism (FLUX.3)
presets.prompt: A photorealistic RAW photograph shot with a professional camera: natural lighting, realistic skin and surface textures, sharp focus on the subject, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, muted natural colors.

presets.name: Portrait Photo (FLUX.3)
presets.prompt: A professional portrait photograph: detailed face with realistic skin texture and visible pores, natural window light, catchlights in the eyes, 85mm lens, creamy bokeh background, honest natural expression.

presets.name: Cinematic Still (FLUX.3)
presets.prompt: A cinematic film still: dramatic lighting with strong contrast, anamorphic lens character, film grain, movie color grading with teal and orange tones, carefully staged depth composition, 35mm cinema look.

presets.name: Concept Art (FLUX.3)
presets.prompt: Professional concept art: matte-painting technique, cinematic composition, wide tonal range, painterly rendering, production-design quality for film or games.
